qa_pairs.question: What is Rorqual in the context of the Metrix portal for Alliance users?
qa_pairs.answer: Rorqual is identified as one of the systems or clusters for which the Metrix portal collects and displays real-time resource usage information for Alliance users.

qa_pairs.question: What is the web address for the Metrix portal specific to the Rorqual cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal for the Rorqual cluster is accessible at https://metrix.rorqual.alliancecan.ca.
